invariants.description: pressure law (Liang 2009 Eq. 9 with its viscoelastic term): u = (e E_A_eff + E_B)(q - q_us)/(1 - k_S dq/dt) + u_ext, dq/dt = v_in - v_out, with E_A_eff = E_A + Delta_E
invariants.expr: (np.max(np.abs(u - ((e*E_A_eff + E_B)*(q - q_us)/(1 - k_S*(v_in - v_out)) + u_ext))) <= 1e-9*max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(u)))) & (np.max(np.abs(E_A_eff - (E_A + Delta_E))) <= 1e-9*abs(E_A))

invariants.description: the activation stays in [0, 1] and reaches 1 in systole (the chamber contracts)
diastole: e = 0 for the fraction 1 - (T_c + T_r)/T of each beat (contraction T_c, relaxation T_r), over the whole beats after the first, within 2 % of a beat
the activation repeats every beat: e(t + T) = e(t) after the first beat (to the solver tolerance)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(e[(t >= T) & (t <= t[-1] - T)] - np.interp(t[(t >= T) & (t <= t[-1] - T)] + T, t, e))) <= 1e-3

invariants.description: volume balance: dq/dt = v_in - v_out, so with constant flows q = q_init + (v_in - v_out) t

bc_sweep.rationale: Factors 0.5-2 on every constant and boundary condition (E_A, E_B, q_us, q_init, T_c, T_r, t_start, flows, u_ext). Delta_E (the elastance change a controller adds; 0 by default) takes -50 % to +100 % of E_A. The beat period T is valid over 0.4-1.5 s (40-150 bpm); points outside are skipped, as are points where contraction plus relaxation would not fit in the beat (T_c + T_r >= T). mt and T_eff are excluded: the harness clock drives them. The activation switches phase discontinuously, so CVODE needs a step cap below the clock's start window (eps_1 = 7 % of a beat): MaximumStep 1 ms.
